lines.say: Thanks for making time. So we are looking at this for our support team, about forty people.
Great, let me get you the numbers. Friday, what does the workspace plan cost per month?
Sorry, quick one before that, is that billed monthly or annual?
Monthly, with an annual option. Maya, what is your current tool costing you?
About two thousand a month, and honestly nobody on the team likes it.
And the migration from that tool is about a day, we did it for two customers last month.
Okay, that works for us. Could we do a pilot first?
Yes. Friday, how many agents come with a new workspace?
While that runs, Maya, who else needs to sign off on your side?
Just my VP, I can get him on a call next week.

expect.why: the price, before the call ends
talk between people; only the ready price, at a pause
'Friday, go ahead' hands the floor back; it is not a new question
talk between people; only the ready answer, at a pause
none of these asks Friday for anything
2 acknowledgements + 2 answers, with room for an answer in two sentences; more is filler
internal names on a customer call
